single_variable: Require direction times the last publicly settled funding rate to be strictly negative, meaning the proposed side would have received the preceding settlement. This is a positioning indicator only; no future settlements or predicted rates enter admission. Control/reference freely enters all otherwise eligible clocks from the same pre-existing panel. No optimized magnitude.
pilot: Fixed liquid 12 Binance USDT perpetual contracts from exp-monday-1618-flow-20261023-v1, using only the coherent archived monthly funding series beginning 2022-09. Include eligible native Binance cloud V1.7 12H keys on both long and short through 2026-09-23 inclusive; preserve this archival selection rather than calling it all history or all symbols.
asof: Use the last settled record strictly before the UTC 12H confirmation, suppressing any record from the same nominal minute. Require the previous funding clock to be within its recorded interval plus one minute and never impute absence to zero. The first available archive month may lack its initial prior record. Report unavailable inputs and actual long/short counts; positive rates favor shorts by construction.
portfolio: Independent 1000U pilot baseline and filtered accounts, same native Binance fixed-stop/EMA runner plus two-thirds resting 2R, 9 unlevered cash-sharing slots. Both accounts are empty at pilot start. Fees 5bp market / 2bp maker. Funding cash flows themselves and impact omitted; an apparent pass requires actual settlements and broader history before accepting any outcome.
decision: Development before 2025 >=100 closed, wins >=30%, realized cash and return payoff >=2.5 and DD conservative <=35%. Run matched-signal, same-parent later non-signal with its own rate screen, and extra 5bp market slippage for a development pass. Report full-period even for rejected pilot. Expand coverage only if the pilot improves growth versus its own panel baseline and clears development gates.
data_source: Local Binance USD-M native monthly fundingRate archives. Exchange reference: https://developers.binance.com/docs/derivatives/usds-margined-futures/market-data/rest-api/Get-Funding-Rate-History
